---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new Terraform module for this repository
title: "[FEAT]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are encountering.

### Proposed Solution / Architectural Enhancement
Describe the module, resource, or architecture changes you would like to see implemented.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### AWS Resources Involved
List the AWS resources that would be created or modified (e.g., `aws_route53_record`, `aws_wafv2_web_acl`, `aws_alb`).

### Security & Compliance Considerations
Detail any security, encryption, compliance, or cost implications of this enhancement.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or references to AWS Best Practices.
